entries.zh: 万民，全体民众；一切人
entries.en: all men; all the people, all mankind

entries.zh: 满地，遍地都是；整片土地
entries.en: all over the ground; the whole earth, all the land

entries.zh: 遍地，到处；处处都是
entries.en: all over the ground; everywhere

entries.zh: 满处，处处、到处；每个地方
entries.en: every place; everywhere

entries.zh: 平生，一生、一辈子；毕生
entries.en: all one's life; one's whole life long

entries.zh: 平素，平日、素来；惯常
entries.en: ordinarily, as a rule; habitually

entries.zh: 满面，满脸；全脸（如满面愁容）
entries.en: the whole face; all over the face (e.g. all smiles, all tears)
entries.notes: 西语词头 toda la vida 与汉栏「满面」义不合，当系同页通栏词头的宽泛系联；汉栏与音写明确指「满脸」。

entries.zh: 平日，平常的日子；平时
entries.en: ordinary days; on ordinary days, usually

entries.zh: 终身，一辈子；至死、毕生
entries.en: for one's whole life; lifelong, until death

entries.zh: 全都完好无缺（原样例句「整我有」：我存有的都是整件）；「整」＝完整无缺
entries.en: all whole and intact; sample phrase "I have them (all) whole" (Sp. enteros)
entries.notes: 三字样例句「整我有」句法欠通，据西语 enteros（完好整件）推读为「我存有完整的」，句读存疑。

entries.zh: 整尽，全都完结；用尽、悉数了结
entries.en: all finished or used up; entirely done

entries.zh: 件件，每一样东西；样样、事事
entries.en: every single thing; each and every item

entries.zh: 每时，随时、任何时候；时时
entries.en: at all times; always, every time

entries.zh: 一繫（疑即「一概／一皆」），一并、全部；统统一起
entries.en: all together; in one lot, without exception
entries.notes: 「繫」字与其音写不相应，疑为「一概／一皆」形误；按西语 todos juntos 释义为「全部一起」。

entries.zh: 共计，总共；合起来算
entries.en: altogether; counted together, in total

entries.zh: 合总，合计总共；一并总计
entries.en: all totaled; in a grand total

entries.zh: 朗总（即「拢总」），总共、统统；一共
entries.en: altogether; all in total
entries.notes: 「朗总」即闽南语「拢总」之别写，义为统统、总共。

entries.zh: 大允（疑即「大凡」），凡是、一律；大抵总是
entries.en: generally, in all cases; every time
entries.notes: 「允」疑为「凡」之形误，西语 todas las veces（每一回）与「大凡＝一律」相合。

entries.zh: 透日，整日、从早到晚；终日
entries.en: all day long; the whole day through

entries.zh: 透年，整年、全年；一年到头
entries.en: all year long; the whole year through

entries.zh: 透月日，整月连日；连月累日（西语对应「整一个月」）
entries.en: whole months and days on end; a full month (Sp. todo un mes)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕疑作「重重尽」：全都加倍／层叠到底；西语 todo doblado（全都加倍）与 todo trabado（全都纠结相连）两读难定
entries.en: 〔damaged original, gloss uncertain〕probably "all doubled / heaped up completely"; Spanish reading unresolved (todo doblado vs. todo trabado)
entries.notes: 词头与中字均标〔疑〕（中字上/卜难辨），据音写暂拟「重重尽＝全都加倍」，语义无法定夺。
